note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 12, HAI 15, 22; A06b Const 12, HAI 15, 22; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Dual citizenship restriction), A02a (birth in country: Group restriction: only if parent is member of a particular group, race or religion) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory only on the condition the dataset states; by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. The coding also records a dual-citizenship restriction on descent and a restriction to members of a particular group, which the form holds only in the condition's words, which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Haiti, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Haiti for 5 years. ... Oath of renunciation of citizenship of another country required (proof of renunciation is not required). ... n.a. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Haiti to a citizen by birth who has never renounced his/her citizenship. ... Dual citizenship restriction ... Person is born abroad to two citizens who have never renounced their citizenship.; Person is born abroad to a father who is not a citizen and a mother who is a citizen. Declaration must be lodged within one year of reaching the age of majority. ... Group restriction: only if parent is member of a particular group, race or religion ... Person is born in Haiti to a father who is an alien and of the African race, or, in case of non-recognition, to a mother who is an alien and of the African race. ... No provision

atBirth.soilIf: Person is born in Haiti to a father who is an alien and of the African race, or, in case of non-recognition, to a mother who is an alien and of the African race.
atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad to two citizens who have never renounced their citizenship.; Person is born abroad to a father who is not a citizen and a mother who is a citizen. Declaration must be lodged within one year of reaching the age of majority.
